title: Liability
summary: LIABIL'ITY, noun 1. The state of being bound or obliged in law or justice; responsibility. The officer wishes to discharge himself from his liability 2. Exposedness; tendency; a state of being subject

inlines.v: LIABIL'ITY, noun 1. The state of being bound or obliged in law or justice; responsibility. The officer wishes to discharge himself from his liability 2. Exposedness; tendency; a state of being subject; as the liableness of a man to contract disease in an infected room; a liability to accidents.
